text: Built-in AssistantAgent lets you define an LLM-backed agent that can call tools
quote: AssistantAgent is a built-in agent that uses a language model and has the ability to use tools.

text: RoundRobinGroupChat lets multiple agents share context and take turns responding
quote: RoundRobinGroupChat is a simple yet effective team configuration where all agents share the same context and take turns responding in a round-robin fashion.

text: UserProxyAgent lets a human provide feedback/input into a running agent team
quote: The UserProxyAgent is a special built-in agent that acts as a proxy for a user to provide feedback to the team.

text: Visual builder lets you create agent teams via JSON or drag-and-drop UI
quote: A visual interface for creating agent teams through declarative specification (JSON) or drag-and-drop

text: Teams built visually can be exported and run as standalone Python code
quote: Export and run teams in python code

text: Agents can be connected to external tools via MCP servers, e.g. a Playwright MCP server for web browsing
quote: Create a web browsing assistant agent that uses the Playwright MCP server.

text: AgentTool enables composing basic multi-agent orchestration setups
quote: You can use `AgentTool` to create a basic multi-agent orchestration setup.

text: Interactive environment lets you test and run agent teams directly
quote: Interactive environment for testing and running agent teams

text: Central hub lets users discover and import community-created agent components
quote: Central hub for discovering and importing community-created components

text: Installable via pip as an official Python package (autogen-agentchat)
Developers can create custom agents with their own custom behaviors
quote: Create your own agents with custom behaviors

text: SelectorGroupChat coordinates multiple agents via a shared context with a centralized, customizable selector
quote: Multi-agent coordination through a shared context and centralized, customizable selector

text: Swarm-style coordination lets agents share context with a localized, tool-based selector for handoffs
quote: Multi-agent coordination through a shared context and localized, tool-based selector

text: Agents can be composed into a directed graph workflow with branching paths
quote: Multi-agent workflows through a directed graph of agents.

text: Agents can be given memory capabilities to retain information
quote: Add memory capabilities to your agents
